_comment: Containment parity between the JS and PHP conditional-logic evaluators.
Sibling of conditional-logic-behaviour.json, which pins how a single comparison behaves.
This pins what happens once containers are in play: which fields a hidden container
takes down with it, and whether an enclosed field's answer still counts for anyone else.
Containment is written twice -- Conditional_Logic_Container::apply_containment in PHP and
applyContainment in evaluate.ts -- and the two are wired into the same fixed point on
both sides. A disagreement means the browser and the server enforce different fields, so
the form either blocks on a question nobody was shown or stores an answer for one that
was hidden. Consumed by evaluate.test.js and Conditional_Logic_Containment_Test.php,
which must agree case for case.
Each field is a text field. `rule` gives it a one-rule condition on another field;
`action` defaults to show. `contains` maps a container id to the field ids it encloses.
`expect` is the resolved visibility every id must end up with.

cases.name: a hidden container hides the field it encloses
a visible container leaves an enclosed field alone
a visible container does not re-show a field its own rules hid
cases.why: Containment only ever forces false. A container becoming visible must not override the enclosed field's own verdict.

cases.name: a field hidden only by its container cannot unlock a field outside it
cases.why: The evaluator blanks a hidden field's value so an unasked question cannot satisfy another rule. A field hidden by containment has to obey that too, or the form validates and stores a field unlocked by an answer it discards.

cases.name: a visible container's enclosed answer still counts for a field outside it
a hidden outer container hides a field inside a nested one
cases.why: The harvest attributes a field to every container open around it, so both ids carry it.

cases.name: a hidden container with a hide action still hides what it encloses
a container naming a field that is not in the form is left visible
cases.why: Fail open. A rule whose subject was renamed or deleted must not hide a group and silently drop everything in it.
